title: Prior Wenlock, met in Emberfall (reached by travelling due west from the Vale, past Thornwold), describes Brother Osk as 'A novice of the gray, this far east' — a compass direction that reads backwards for a location the player just walked west to reach.
where: The Priory of Ash (Emberfall) / talk to Prior Wenlock, 'your gray-robed companion'
